question: Alvars were the devotees of which South Indian cult?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Vaishnavism**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Alvars:-**

 
 
• **The Alvars were a group of Tamil poet-saints who lived between the 6th and 9th centuries CE.**
 
• They were devoted to the worship of Lord Vishnu, and their poetry and hymns played a significant role in the development of the Bhakti movement in South India.
